quote:
What is karma? What is dharma?
To perform actions, as shown by scriptures, for one’s own benefit is karma.
To perform the same actions for the welfare of the world is dharma.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: For the abundant grace showered by the Guru, I thought I can only prostrate unto him! While thinking so, I also thought, for that grace bestowed, how many times do I keep prostrating? For how long should I keep prostrating for the grace he bestowed?
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: To be humane is good; to love all that can feel our love is truly great
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Only when you have faith that the deity you are devoted to can bestow anything, will you be able to do bhakti with faith. Other deities may help you in some matters and fail you in others. Hence we should always seek refuge in Lord Krishna alone.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Prostrating with one’s chest, head, mind, body, word, feet, knees and arms touching the earth amounts to performing ashtanga namaskara with eight parts.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: All of one’s emotions are relative to time, space and person only.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Try to leave ‘I’, ‘I’ in each saying and happening.  Instead, try to catch ‘Krishna’, ‘Krishna’ (‘He’) in every happening and saying.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: God has not given man the capacity to see his own back. Do you know why? That is because God intends to say – Don’t worry about the past that has gone behind you. Start chanting Nama from today and go ahead.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: I admire the philosophy which makes me realize that I have been liberated in my lifetime itself.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Those who do not chant the Divine Names of God  are seeking help from outside. Those who chant the Divine Names of God receive help from within.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A few are interested in developing their body; a few are interested in developing their knowledge. But knowingly or unknowingly all are developing their vasanas (latent tendencies).
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: At the time of death, one experiences an unimaginable and indescribable pain. It disturbs the mind. Innumerable waves of thoughts traverse the disturbed mind. At that time, the very final thought determines one’s next birth.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Whilst the entire world tried to explore into the object,  our ancient Rishis alone explored into the subject.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Condemning bad alone  is not enough. Appreciating good is also needed to avoid bad in the future
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Total knowledge, unconditional love, total surrender – one among these three alone can make us realize God.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One blessed with a long life, high social status, beauty, opulence or good health does not automatically qualify to be meritorious.  Only the one who leads his entire life without sinning, indeed, is meritorious.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: In general, one accrues merits when he offers something in charity and not when he receives something from others. Whereas, one accrues merits both, while offering something to a Mahan as well as receiving something from them.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If we chant looking at the time, the results also take time
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: When science is silent, spirituality speaketh!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Man shows to what extent he can destroy this human birth; Mahans show how greatly useful it can be made!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: When one is afflicted with sorrow, if he persists in prayers and not question the Lord as to why He is putting him into grief, when the difficult times pass, the Lord is pleased and rewards him with a special gift of His grace.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Walking will burn your colestrol. Chanting will burn your sins.  Chanting while walking will burn both.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The prayers are always from the soul, the different methods are from the mind.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Thinking of God is vital: thanking God is more vital.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Incarnations will always have a bond with this earth
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
I came to you Oh! Lord! With a heavy heart and empty hands!
Now, after chanting the Mahamantra,
My heart is light and hands are full with your gifts!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: God’s grace always flows in abundance. It is upto you to be ready to receive it.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The devotion of ordinary people is first recognized by the world and later by God. However, the devotion of Mahatmas is first recognized by God. It is God who then makes it known to the world.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The whole world is bound by the Lord. The Lord is bound by His Divine Names.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Who can be termed as selfish? The one who worries about his own well-being unmindful of troubles to others.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Improper meditation leads to medication.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: When there is true love, even adversities appear to be blessings.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
Lord Vishnu’s abode is Paramapadha
Lord Krishna’s abode is Premapadha.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
Working for the world makes your life happy
Working for God makes your life blissful.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A good family is a family which chants Nama regularly.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: In spiritual life, never go in for a second opinion. Good or bad, stick to one belief and develop unshakeable faith. When a trouble befalls you, it is only to test your faith. Win over it by your faith on God. He will never let you down.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The moment we come in contact with a Sadguru we are cleansed of all sins. We become pure. Thus, it is not right to then think of us as sinners.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The Divine Name of Krishna is the real flame that burns darkness of ignorance and ignites the light of knowledge.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Your last breath should ensure that this is your last birth.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Oh Ye Friend! Arise! The Moment has come to start the Mahamantra Movement and take it to the world!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Joy and sorrow are the only two known states of mind as far as man is concerned. Divinity is to get past this dual state and be in a constant state of bliss.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: As long the “I” remains, you are going to die. As long as you die, the ‘ I” will continue to live!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Of what good is tall talk that your Guru is God himself? If you really believed it, it would reflect in your actions!  As they say “If you talk the talk, you have to walk the walk!”
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: When you are at tension, pay attention to Maha Mantra.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A person can win over the entire world simply by perfecting the art of fine behavior.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: This name and that name might come and go, but the Divine Name is Eternal.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If your mind does not rest in the Self, you will be restless.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: God created men without bias, God created the world without bias, but men created God with bias.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Leaving Nama, there is no meaning in living.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: World peace is in your word and that word is the Divine Name of Lord.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Where there is lust, there is no Lord.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One’s mere presence near the flower will suffice to get its fragrance. Likewise, merely remaining in the Sadhu’s presence is enough to feel the divinity.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If you develop love it is meditation. If you chant you shall develop love. So chanting is nothing but meditation.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The heart beat and the pulse are examined by doctors through the appropriate instruments. Similarly through inward directed vision and focussed mind, the ‘Anahata’ sound and ‘aham spurana’ can be experienced
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The salt, sugar and the fat in our food affect the organs in the body like the heart, the kidney and the eyes.  Mind is also an internal organ. The saltiness, sourness and spices in our food affect this internal organ called the mind.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A true devotee expects grace from the Lord like a lover expecting a gift from the beloved. The Sadhak expects grace from the Lord like an employee expecting the wages from the Master.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A solitary rose or a jasmine flower smells great, no doubt. But it can never match the sweet fragrance of a bouquet full of them. Likewise, chanting Nama individually is great, but more radiant are the vibes generated by chanting as a group.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
If the body dies you are born again. If the mind dies you are never born again.
When we speak of death, it is only to the physical body. Death of the mind is liberation!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If man is Humble and Adheres to His Guru’s word always, he becomes a ‘Mahan’
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Mahaprabhu made lions and tigers sing and dance to the tune of Nama Kirtan. What does this go to show? If you chant the Maha Mantra constantly, the whole world will be at your feet!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: We may have taken thousands of births and committed millions of sins.  No matter how colossal that figure may be, it is unquestionably well within the realm of the finite.   God’s boundless grace though, is immeasurable, limitless and infinite!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Our head contains the thousand petal lotus called ‘SahasrAra’.  When we prostrate to the Lord or our Guru by placing our head at His feet, we offer this precious lotus to His feet.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: As long as there is attachment to body, even if a person thinks that he is in solitude, he is not.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Rather than speak at length about the greatness of the divine name, prove it by chanting.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: It does not matter how many square feet make up the area of your home.  What really matters is how many Sadhus have been fed there!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A Mahan is like a ball of fire — one gets warmth and comfort by merely being in his presence.  But it is dangerous to exceed the limits, for one gets burnt and reduced to ashes.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The world shown by the mind is not at all true. It is only as true as a chronic liar, who vehemently swears on truth, that he never lies and had never lied!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Compromise anything for the world. Compromise nothing for God.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If you count on luck, you risk being forsaken sooner or later.  If you count on talent, you are sure to go places.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: God Realization is not a process.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Truth is one, lies are many.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: How cruel is the Maya of this world!  The world tries to make a living by exploiting even those Jnanis- liberated ones who have given up all bondages and possessions.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The mind would look at others and say “This life is a myth. The whole world as we see it is an illusion. This physical body is impermanent.”  Should not the mind be saying this to itself in the first place?
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Before we venture into any task – be it worldly or divine, we should first think constructively about its greatness and learn to love it.  Then that task itself becomes a source of joy.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Bhakti is all about showing gratitude.  A Guru shows us how to show our gratitude to the Lord.  Showing gratitude to the Guru for showing us how to show gratitude to the Lord is Guru Bhakti.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If you analyze your mind without the grace of Guru or Sri Hari, you will end up with psychological problems.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: An ideal Guru will never allow his disciple to carry a bit of his burden and will not carry a bit of his disciple’s burden.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Eyes are the windows to see one’s mind.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Maha Mantra is precious; so precious that Krishna blesses this Mantra only to people whom he loves the most.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Already we have various procedures, thoughts and techniques.   The need of the hour is a simple procedure to reach God realization without contradicting the already established faith.    Undoubtedly, that is faith in the glory of His Eternal Name!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Divine Life is a battle between one truth and many lies
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Learn to love others before you expect to be loved by them.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: An ordinary person bends towards the mass, but the extraordinary person bends the mass towards himself.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Just as Arjuna had meticulous focus only on the bird’s eye as instructed by his preceptor Dronacharya, so be our mind with unflinching attention on Maha Mantra and Maha Mantra alone!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: More than worrying that we uttered a wrong word, we should really be more concerned that we have in us the underlying vasana (tendency) that made us utter such a word.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
There is an intimate everlasting connection between the spiritual practice and the Mahatma who propagated the same.
If a person who has not even heard of Mahaprabhu,  chants Mahamantra incessantly, he shall have Mahaprabhu’s darshan.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Oh Krishna, Do make my life purposeful, atleast to me, if not even for others.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Any religion that does not preach love may be for a small region but not for the entire world
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Always pray for higher resolution of your mind. It is the real prayer.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: To those who chant the Divine Name, Lord Krishna of Udupi bestows ample food, Lord Srinivasa of Tirupathi bestows enough wealth, Lord Panduranga merrily dances to the tunes of their Kirtan.  What else should one worry about?
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: People always bother about the destination. Instead, it would be wiser if one were to take care that one is on the right path and is journeying along the same correctly
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
Love to live
Live to love
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Giving up enquiry into and analysis of the various affairs of the world if you would analyse yourself, your faults and inquire into the corrective steps to be taken in this direction you can attain the Lord. This is certain.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
Selfishness throws you far from the Self;
Selflessness brings you closer to the Self.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: For a good Bhakta the very thought of the Lord or the Guru itself is joy (‘smarane sukham’)!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: ‘I” represents the ego and ” O” represents universality. If we replace the “I” in “living” with “O”,  it will become “loving” indeed!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Throne of Bhagavan is Faith and not a golden throne!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The path of Jnana is challenging and adventurous. Because of that itself, only few can taste success in that path. But the path of Bhakthi is lyrical and full of beauty. That is why it is recommended to all.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Sadhu is not one who remains quiet even when hit but means one who has given up all desires
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One who seeks wealth prays God for money. One who desires fame and power prays God for attainment of the same. Only the one who truly wishes to attain eternal peace  seeks God for the sake of God alone.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Chanting Hari Naam will make us chat with Hari!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The Guru cannot be likened to a precious gem because the wealthy alone would be able to purchase it. The Guru can be likened to that rare life-giving herb which may grow by the roadside because the genuine seeker alone will be able to spot it.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: When we bow down before others, rather than think that we glorify them by doing so, it is best to think that Sri Krishna will be happy with us because we are grooming ourselves to be humble!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: It is most regrettable and surprising to see that even in this modern age, there exist parents who are unhappy if a girl child is born and give preferential treatment to boys over girls even at home.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Inequalities with regards to caste, religion and race exist even today and those that imagine themselves to be superior do not treat the rest even as they would treat fellow human beings,  but look down upon them as if they are lowly creatures.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Disability is not limited to the physical body alone. True disability is mental weakness and suspicious nature
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: For those who have advanced well in spirituality, the mind will verily become the Guru and lead them.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One day, the mind would be filled with devotion; on another day, it would long for the worldly pleasures;  on another day, it would renounce everything.  The great Maya called the ‘Mind’ can be brought under control slowly only through Nama Sankirtan
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: When Lord Krishna tolerates your innumerable sins, why cannot you tolerate the mistakes of others?
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
All those who can think above and beyond the level of the normal human mind that confines itself within a tiny radius, are greater souls indeed, to that extent
– HH Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
A frog croaks and unwittingly signals to the snake to swallow it, thereby losing its life!
Likewise every moment spent in gossip and worthless talk is a signal and an invitation to Yama ( God of Death) to come and finish us off!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
Think God!
Thank God!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji
HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Attempting to control the mind while having variety of tasty dishes is like desiring to sit and stand at the same time!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
God is great!
Belief in god is greater!
Faith in god is the greatest!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
A Gnani can identify a Gnani
A Bhaktha can identify a Bhaktha
A Yogi can identify a Yogi,
Nobody else!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: We like to wear dresses of varied colors; we like to eat different cuisines.  The Lord being a ‘rasika’ also sports different forms and names in the same way.  What is wrong with that?
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Just as a good father thinks of somehow making his child study even if he has to use various means – petting, pleading, beating or threatening, so too does the Lord think of bestowing Jnãna on His true Bhakta even if it be through harsh treatment.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Those who read Srimad Bhagavatam need not read Bhagavat Gita separately because Sage Veda Vyasa has written Srimad Bhagavatam as a commentary for the Bhagavat Gita.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Living with a Saint is entirely different from reading about a Saint
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Chanting lips make many hands work
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Srimad Bhagavatam, which is born of Sri Veda Vyasa, who is the authority of all the Vedas and Sage Narada who is the epitome of devotion (Bhakti), is undoubtedly the essence of both Vaideeka Dharma and Bhagavata Dharma
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Brindavan is my home. Those who perform Nama Sankirtan are my relatives.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Even those who had been doing Bhakti for attaining Bhagavat darshan at some point of time, due to delusion, begin to strive for position, status, wealth and fame. But, there are some who do bhakti (right from the beginning) only to attain these!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Those who have taken refuge in a ‘Uttama Guru’ (True Guru) wonder how others have not been able to understand such a great Mahan and take him to be an ordinary person; whereas, others wonder how these people remain bound by him!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: We find that a man blessed with all comforts in life remains drowned in liquor, in spite of many things of joy in the outside world. This is proof enough that joy earned from ‘within’ is greater than that earned from ‘without’!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: An orphan is not one who has no parents but one who has no Guru!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Mahans will never, knowingly or unknowingly, punish anyone for the wrong done. They do not know to punish. To ‘teach a lesson’ is not in their nature. All that they know to teach is Bhagavata dharma!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: What is the point of leading lives filled with compromises trying to gain the acceptance of all in the world? The only one who should accept us is God. Let us lead lives with that focus alone!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: We celebrate birthdays merrily with the perception that it is growth in terms of age. Do we stop for a moment and realize that it actually also means that the time left for us to realize God in this lifetime is decreasing?
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Equality, simplicity, and purity prevail in the presence of true saints.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Bhakti shows the Lord. But, where does one find Bhakti? In the Lord? No! Not in Him! In temples? No! Not in temples! Only in the company of a Bhakta!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: In gratitude to the Grace bestowed on me by Bhagavaan I intensified my japa and dhyaana. But, I realized that here again Bhagavaan bestowed their ‘phala’ (fruits) on me!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A person rendering services as desired by the Mahatma, with bhakti and ‘shraddha’, need not grieve for not performing japa or dhyana. The devoted service that he renders encompasses all these!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The Lord knows how, through whom and when a work has to be done. We should learn to live happily, placing all the burdens on His Holy Feet.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Do not be a burden to Mother Earth. When do you become a burden to Prithvi (Earth)?  Whenever you fail to chant the Divine Names or do Atma vichara! If you chant the Divine Names or do Ãtma vichãra you cease to be a burden to her!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Rather than having expectations, it is always good to accept whatever comes.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: The worst of all vices is moving away from your spiritual path. The purpose of creation is only attainment of liberation. Therefore, every time you move away from your spiritual path you are committing the worst crime!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One should constantly repeat the names of God irrespective of any  activity that he/she might be involved in. Every moment of our life that is  spent without the thought of God is indeed a waste.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If you think liberation is out of reach, the divine Padukas of the Sadguru are the ladder to attain it.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Equality, simplicity, and purity prevail in the presence of true saints.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: As long as one is not sure if the one he saw was Bhagavan, one can be rest assured that it was not God Realization because God-realization does not need another’s confirmation.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: While deeply meditating on God we should pray for forgiveness for all the sins committed due to latent impressions. Further, we should seek His help for abstaining from these. Such sincere prayers will surely be answered.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: As far as possible our sadhana and bhakti should be kept concealed, for, others’ praise and honour shown to us are but blocks in our sadhana.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Though the fact is that it is only our devotion (love) to God that comes back to us as ‘GRACE’, the RETURN is immeasurably higher than our devotion; just as the light that falls on the mirror is reflected manifold.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
In Treta Yuga Rama was required to redeem Ahalya. However, in Kali Yuga Rama Naama (the Divine Name of Rama)
would suffice!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Faith is wealth. When there is no faith even if God Himself were to appear before us we will ignore Him and thus lose Him. But, if we possess faith, God will appear even in a stone and speak to us. Faith is the foundation for everything.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Who is a ‘gunavan’ (the virtuous)? Only one who exerts efforts to control and destroy the mind is a ‘gunavan’!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: It is impossible for you to understand the actions of a Mahatma; but it is sufficient to understand that whatever He does, it will be only for your good.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: People speak of seven wonders of the world. But, these are not the real wonders. The real wonder is the way the Mahans wander about in this world, in spite of their high state!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If the Almighty demands anything from us while we do not have the capacity to offer, would it not sadden us? So what does He do? He first bestows the capability on the one from whom he desires to have a thing and then places His demands!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Mind (‘manas’) is verily the worst sin! Destroying the mind is the greatest ‘punya’ (merit)!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One is truly wise if he exactly knows all that he does not know!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A Yogi with lot of effort controls his breath and holds the Lord within him but in the case of a Bhakta it is the Lord who goes around him!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: If someone can instill in you, faith on Krishna, then He is the Master that you can have faith on.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: <div id="_mcePaste">When one commits a mistake, doesn’t he take utmost care and caution to ensure that it is not known to others? One should take similar care and caution to be totally inconspicuous when he does an act of public good.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: There does not exist a problem that does not have a solution. If a problem exists, then the solution also exists somewhere. Its just that one has not found the solution and applied it to the problem yet. Never give up the search for the solution.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: See, perceive, relish; but do not want to possess. This is the secret of happiness.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: <div id="_mcePaste">Words of a common man, even if they convey a lofty ideal, are mere words but those falling out of the lips of Mahans, though may sound commonplace, make an invaluable counsel <em>(Upadesh)
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Even if you approach Krishna for worldly matters in the beginning, he will slowly make you understand His real and true nature.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Make your life perfect by never doing things that you despise in others.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: God created Man according to His wish.  Man created God according to his wish too!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: It is one thing to perform spiritual sadhana as a means to attain God.  It is an entirely different thing to develop love for God first and then perform spiritual sadhana as a means to attain Him.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: There are two ways to overcome Maya.  The Vedanti fights against it whereas the Bhakta takes shelter under the Divine Names of God
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: A person who toils hard all day is justified in seeking a fitting reward from his employer at the end of the day.  Likewise, only one who leads a life filled with divine thoughts is justified in seeking liberation.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote:
Ram Nam Ram Nam shakes your ego
Ram Nam Ram Nam makes you calm
Ram Nam Ram Nam wakes your wisdom
Ram Nam Ram Name takes you home
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: One must take a dip with garments on at the sight of those who call the power of Divine Names and the words of the Holy text Srimad Bhagavatam as mere eulogy or exaggeration.
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji

quote: Oh Krishna! Whether or not I do good deeds is secondary! But firstly, please keep me from doing sins!
attribution: HH Maharanyam Sri Sri Muralidhara Swamiji
